title: Chapter 1296
text:
Within a few days, the sanctions issued by the three Universal Civilizations directly ignited public opinion in the entire galactic society. Be it ordinary people or Supers, civilization organizations, or civilian organizations, they were all in an uproar!

The Beyond Grade A Association had partners in every field. This sanctions order had too many implications, almost involving all aspects of the galactic society. Rashly terminating the cooperation with the entire Beyond Grade A Association would affect the operation of the entire explored universe!

The three Universal Civilizations had ruled for many years, and as the guardians of order, it was inevitable that they would gradually become corrupt and conservative. Many people's fear of the three Universal Civilizations came from their ruling status and huge forces, but they gradually forgot the fierceness of the three Universal Civilizations. This decree awakened the memories of many civilizations buried in history, remembering the bloody history of the three Universal Civilizations.

In the eyes of many civilizations, the three Universal Civilizations seemed to be wiping away the rust on their bodies, slowly regaining the viciousness they had during their rise. Many people were secretly worried, not knowing how much of their sharpness the three Universal Civilizations would be able to regain.

On the quantum network, the public opinion was the most explosive. The Supers were in an uproar, expressing extreme indignation toward this decree. They felt that the three Universal Civilizations' excuse for sanctions was bullsh * t.

In their eyes, the association had not done anything unforgivable until now. The three Universal Civilizations' motive was nothing more than their overbearing desire to control. This made countless Supers feel extremely disgusted, thinking that this was an infringement on the freedom of all Supers.

For a time, the association's voice among the Supers rose again. Countless Supers supported the association, thinking that this was an unfair sanction. The public opinion continued to soar.

However, it was unrealistic to say that the three Universal Civilizations' methods were ineffective. The support of the Supers was basically limited to slogans. No one wanted to take risks. Seeing the three Universal Civilizations' attitude toward sanctions was so firm, some Supers who originally wanted to join the association were scared away by the terms of the sanctions order …

It was human nature to seek benefits and avoid harm. One could be shameless on the internet, but one's body was still very honest.

However, this method had no effect on the players. Instead, it caused widespread dissatisfaction. Not only were the players of the Beyond Grade A organizations annoyed, but even some players from the neutral faction and even the three Universal Civilizations' own faction were annoyed.

To the players, they could work for others and do missions, but they could not be forced. The three Universal Civilizations' actions of forcing them to take sides stimulated the reverse psychology of some players.

So what if you're from the three Universal Civilizations? Why don't you take a look at this version? Do you think we're all afraid of you?

The players themselves were a part of the Super class and were naturally close to the association. This punishment indirectly strengthened the determination of some players to join the association, increasing the speed at which the players of various organizations switched to the association. After all, they were not afraid of death. They would just have to face it head-on!

While public opinion was going wild, the Beyond Grade A Association held an emergency meeting under Han Xiao's call.

…

Finn Planet, Association Great Hall.

This time, no one was late. The projections of many Beyond Grade As were already present, sitting upright with solemn expressions.

However, not everyone was present. Some of the seats around the round table that should have been occupied were currently empty.

At this moment, everyone's eyes were focused on Han Xiao.

Han Xiao looked around the room, put his hands on his nose, and faced everyone's gazes.

"I'm sure all of you know why I called for this meeting. The three Universal Civilizations have announced sanctions against us, so we have to return the favor and retaliate."

As he spoke, he pointed at the empty seat and calmly said, "You've all seen it.

The direct members of the three Universal Civilizations did not attend the meeting. I've temporarily terminated their membership rights. At the same time, we will no longer provide any form of help to the three Universal Civilizations, including but not limited to Beyond Grade A military support and technical support … If you have any objections, you can stand up now. "

As soon as he said that, the room was immediately filled with 'seconded' voices.

The key to these two orders was to obtain the consent of the Beyond Grade A allies of the three Universal Civilizations. After all, the allies were not direct members, and not everyone had a bad relationship with the civilizations.

However, the three Universal Civilizations did not give them any leeway this time and even treated their allies as targets to force them out of the association. Most of the allies were dissatisfied.

Only a few of them were hesitant because of different concerns. However, before the situation became clear, they could not immediately withdraw from the association to avoid the sanctions because they were already in a difficult position. If they did not advance or retreat with the association, they would not be able to survive in the Beyond Grade A circle in the future. Furthermore, the attitude of the three Universal Civilizations toward the Beyond Grade As was not worthy of their high hopes.

Furthermore, the Sanctum Revival involved a second life. In their eyes, they were naturally more important than external forces.

The core of most Beyond Grade A organizations was the strength of their leader. As long as their fist was still there, even if their organization was attacked in all kinds of ways, they could still make a comeback at any time. They were all people who relied on their abilities to make a living, so they did not panic.

Most of them knew that the goal of unity was for the sake of class interests. The three Universal Civilizations had already revealed their strength. If they did not unite to fight against them now, they might not have a chance in the future. Temporary gains and losses were not important at the moment. Only those who were extremely short-sighted would think of leaving the association to protect themselves.

Now, the association had already played the role that they had originally envisioned, becoming the link of the Beyond Grade A united front. Even if some people had different thoughts, they could only stand on the association's side for the time being and unite closely beside Han Xiao.

"Since everyone agrees, these two orders will be implemented until the three Universal Civilizations revoke the sanctions." Han Xiao narrowed his eyes.

To be honest, he had long wanted to get rid of the direct members of the three Universal Civilizations, but he never had a good opportunity. Now, they had given him an excuse.

Milizaus stroked his beard and said with a deep voice, "No matter what, the sanctions are a problem for us. Black Star, what do you plan to do next?"

Han Xiao tapped the table and slowly said, "Channels, territory, manpower, funds … These are the entry points of the three Universal Civilizations to suppress us. Resisting the pressure will be the focus of the next step. It is imperative to shrink our business and streamline our scale. Among them, the biggest hit will be the channels. This sanctions has almost taken away our normal trading rights, and we can't buy resources even if we have money. Therefore, the Galactic Black Market is an important area for us to set up … Secret Master, this will require your help. "

Secret Master nodded slowly.

The managers behind the scenes of the Galactic Black Market were all Beyond Grade As. In the future, the Galactic Black Market would probably serve as the logistics core of the association. There would definitely be a new round of expansion and consolidation of the black market in the entire universe, which would have both advantages and disadvantages for Secret Master and the other managers of the black market.

Han Xiao paused for a moment before continuing. "Also, not everyone in the universe will carry out the sanctions. These organizations are also the ones we should cooperate with."

"For example, the Supercluster?" someone asked tentatively.

Han Xiao glanced at him, smiled, and said, "If the chips are right, the Supercluster is also a choice."

Hearing this, the eyes of some of the Supercluster Beyond Grade As who were disguised as neutral sparkled, and they were secretly overjoyed.

This time, Kasuyi pondered and said, "The Supercluster … it's fine if they cause trouble, but will they be willing to cooperate with us?"

"That will depend on whether both sides can come up with a bargaining chip that both sides are satisfied with. Furthermore, from our standpoint, the Super Star Cluster Alliance also needs us to fight against the three Universal Civilizations. Although the relationship between the two sides can't be considered to be one of mutual dependence, we're both taking what we need."

This time, Manison snorted and said, "I have cooperated with the Supercluster Alliance before, and the reaction of the three Universal Civilizations was not small. If we reach a deal with the Supercluster, the three Universal Civilizations will definitely be greatly affected, and it won't end so easily."

Han Xiao turned around, raised his brows, and said, "Are you afraid?"

"Humph, what do I have to be afraid of?" Manison did not think much of it. "I'm reminding you of the consequences of this."

Han Xiao waved his hands and said, "It's fine. Since the three Universal Civilizations have publicly sanctioned us, they must have assumed the result of us contacting the Supercluster. However, they did not care about this, which means that they are mentally prepared. They might even have the idea of getting rid of us in one fell swoop … But even so, we still have to contact the Supercluster Alliance and let the three Universal Civilizations know that we are not so easy to deal with."

"I thought you would always be loyal to the three Universal Civilizations." Manison snorted, still remembering the grudge from the Intelligent Plague incident.

"I'm only maintaining order. I've never had any loyalty to the three Universal Civilizations. As long as I can maintain order, it doesn't matter who comes," Han Xiao said casually.

Manison said calmly, "You make it sound nice, but aren't you walking on my path now? Looks like I was right in the end. "

Han Xiao did not mind, smiled, and said, "You used the safety of the galactic society to threaten us, and I only made the rulers fear our strength. The two are different in nature. I'm much better than you."

"Humph, all excuses." Manison looked away and did not speak anymore.

Things had already developed to this point. The Virtual Mutiny Virus that had been imitated for many years would probably not be of any use. Manison could not help but feel that it was a pity.

However, the way he saw it, this was a layer of secret insurance. If the association really could not withstand the pressure of the three Universal Civilizations, he would not mind using this trump card to cover for the association and turn it into the situation he had originally envisioned.

Han Xiao did not care about Manison and explained the next action plan in detail. Now, the association needed everyone to work together and not fight on their own. With his current authority, everyone would listen to him obediently.

In the end, Han Xiao paused and said, "If we want to resolve this issue, the three Universal Civilizations will have to resolve it.

"If we want to resolve the situation, we can either get the three Universal Civilizations to revoke the sanctions on their own, or the association will open up a new form of development. Our two paths will go hand in hand … However, actions are actions, and we must control it well. Don't implicate too many innocent people. The purpose of the counterattack is to make the three Universal Civilizations feel troubled, not to intensify the conflict and try to avoid a direct armed conflict. The three Universal Civilizations are pressuring us to force us onto the wrong path. If we pose a huge threat to the galactic society, it will be even more justifiable for them, so don't get ahead of yourself. "

Everyone nodded. They also understood this logic. It was normal to fight, but if the bottom line was crossed, even if it was reasonable, it would become unreasonable.

This meeting lasted for half a day, and the members all took their own responsibilities. The association was originally a loose alliance, but now, it felt more and more like a whole.

After the meeting ended, the projections disappeared one by one, leaving only Han Xiao and Kasuyi in the room.

Kasuyi's tensed expression relaxed, and he smiled. "When are you going to have a showdown with the three Universal Civilizations? They seem to have completely believed that the Sanctum Revival can only be used once. Otherwise, they wouldn't be so radical. "

He was more confident in this battle than anyone else. With the secret of the unlimited Sanctum Revival, he was not afraid of the three Universal Civilizations' little trick of sanctions.

At the same time, Kasuyi also felt that Han Xiao was right to hide this secret. Otherwise, the three Universal Civilizations would not have used such a radical method of probing. In his opinion, this could lure the three Universal Civilizations into making the wrong decision.

"No rush, wait for the right time." Han Xiao waved his hand.

"You know what you're doing anyway. I believe you." Kasuyi nodded and deactivated the projection.

Han Xiao shook his head and smiled, his eyes flashing.

"I guess those Supercluster Beyond Grade As who are pretending to be neutral have already brought my intentions to the Supercluster Alliance …"

…

On the other side, in the Supercluster Alliance, many civilization leaders gathered to listen to the report.

"Are you sure? Black Star said he wants to contact us? "

Many Supercluster Civilization leaders were overjoyed and secretly excited.

"The association is in a difficult situation now and urgently needs a new channel. It also has to fight back against the three Universal Civilizations, so cooperating with us is naturally a very good choice."

The Star Arc Civilization leader spoke with a deep voice, his eyes shining.

Although they had some conflicts with Black Star in the past and did not see eye to eye with each other, that was then and this was now. If they could obtain the help of the Beyond Grade A Association through Black Star, this small grudge was nothing.

The stronger the Beyond Grade A Association was, the more uncomfortable the three Universal Civilizations would feel. The Supercluster Alliance was most willing to see a new variable appear in the universe.

As for offending the three Universal Civilizations by violating the sanctions, the Supercluster Alliance did not care at all. The two sides were like fire and water. Even without this reason, the three Universal Civilizations would suppress them every day.

However, the association only turned to cooperate with them now. It was like quarreling with their real boyfriend, the three Universal Civilizations, and then turning to date the spare tire of the Supercluster …

Thinking of this, many Supercluster leaders felt a little uncomfortable.

However, it didn't take long for everyone to feel relieved.

Forget it, as long as I can get close to her, I'll be the spare tire!

We're happy anyway!
